problem.sharingReview: Review the selected content and external client data policy, then confirm sharing. No source was shared.
notify.title: External proposal ready for review
notify.body: A connected client submitted a proposal. Review it in ReputeCast before applying any changes. Nothing has been sent or published.
problem.fields: Check the connection request fields and try again.
problem.cursor: Use the next cursor from the previous page.
problem.consent: This connection request expired, was already decided, or belongs to another session. Start a new connection in the client.
problem.mfa: Complete two-factor authentication before allowing an external connection.
problem.capabilities: Choose only requested capabilities your current role can grant.
problem.scope: The connection cannot have a broader scope than your current access.
problem.domains: Choose sender domains in this workspace.
problem.ips: Enter valid IP addresses or CIDR networks.
problem.client: Check the client name, callback URIs and authentication method.
problem.sourcePermission: This connection cannot read the selected source. Review its permissions or reconnect.
problem.reportUnavailable: This report cannot be shared. Choose an email campaign sent at least 72 hours ago. A snapshot expires 30 days after its first selection and cannot be recreated.
problem.sourceLimit: This connection already has 50 selected sources. Wait for an old selection to expire.
problem.privateSource: This source contains unsupported or private text. Edit it locally before sharing editorial context.
problem.decisionKind: Use the decision for this proposal's new draft or existing change.
problem.decided: This proposal already has a different decision.
problem.blocked: This proposal can no longer be applied. Review its saved status and request a fresh proposal.
problem.content: The staged content is no longer valid. Create a new proposal.
problem.expired: This proposal expired during validation. Request a fresh proposal.
